entries.title: Merge cards show how many lines a change adds and deletes
entries.body: A card that offers to merge a change now shows how many lines the whole change adds and deletes, beside its pull request or branch and its checks. The count follows the newest version on offer, and a change the app could not count shows no number rather than a zero.

picture.alt: A merge card whose facts read Lines +3 added · −0 deleted between the branch and the passed checks
